prose: Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) connects a coding agent to tools for inspecting apps without their source code: native binaries, JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET assemblies and websites. The agent investigates how a feature works, shows evidence and limits for each conclusion, and can build a version for your project.

Setup is one command, npx rea-agents setup, which registers an MCP server and workflow instructions after you approve the changes. Analysis runs locally and can use an existing Hopper or Ghidra install.
highlights: Agent tooling to reverse engineer apps
Covers native, Electron, .NET and web targets
Local analysis, optional Hopper or Ghidra
